messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-8491 for service `inference-eu-prod` — symptom: embedding queue latency spike >2000ms, sustained for ~3m at 25rps. Auto-paged #incidents. PD: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC8491>
Anya K.: I’m oncall, taking it. ack.
Sahil: @Anya K. ping — is this customer-impacting? any 5xx errors showing?
Anya K.: No widespread 5xx in upstream logs, but several light clients are timing out. Customers reporting ~5% error spike. Initial look points to KV cache backpressure and large batch latencies.
miguel: I'm seeing kvcache evictions and elevated memory churn on node-12 (eu-gpu-4). Snapshot shows repeated GC/oom-protect signals. Suggest reducing max_batch_size and trimming prefix cache.
Anya K.: Adding note to PD. Applying temporary mitigation: reduce `max_batch_size` to 8 on pool `inference-eu-4`. Will rollout to a subset first.
pagerbot: Deploy command queued: `./infra/rollout.sh --pool inference-eu-4 --param max_batch=8 --strategy rolling --batch 3` — started on 3/4 nodes. CI link: <internal-ci/job/rollout/7821>
Sahil: :thumbsup: Good. Monitor latency and errors. If still degrading after 2m, escalate to dedicated-sre and prepare to failover traffic to eu-standby region.
Anya K.: Patch applied to 3 nodes; node-12 still flapping but not OOM'ing. Median latency dropped from ~2400ms -> ~520ms for the patched hosts. Holding watch.
incidentbot: PD update: acknowledged by Anya K.; note added: "reduced batch size; partial rollout; monitoring".
miguel: Running kvcache trim on node-12 to clear long-tail prefixes. Command (dry-run first): `redis-cli -h redis-eu-1 --scan | xargs -n 100 redis-cli -h redis-eu-1 del` — will limit to keys older than 24h.
Anya K.: Performing trim now; also scaling down some heavy replica jobs. @Sahil please prepare a short customer PSA in case we need to proactively notify impacted tenants.
Sahil: Drafting now: "We observed transient inference latency in the EU region earlier today. A mitigation was applied and service is restored for the majority of customers. Our team continues root cause analysis and will follow up with an update"
oncall-ops: Heads-up: handing off in ~20m to nightshift. Proposed handoff -> @miguel for RCA and monitoring.
miguel: Confirmed I will take over follow-ups and the RCA. Current status: stable, tail latency reduced, watch window set to 15m.
Anya K.: Updating PD: status -> monitoring. Leaving rollout id and relevant logs: `rollout-id: r-3450012345-eu-batch-tweak` and `logs: /var/log/infra/rollout/7821.log`
incidentbot: PD note added; incident marked as `monitoring`.
Anya K.: Closing the active alerts in channel for now. Will re-open thread if regressions occur. :white_check_mark:
